title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm used to minimize the cost function in machine learning models. It iteratively adjusts the parameters to find the minimum value of the cost function.

title: Convex vs Non-Convex Functions
text: A convex function has a single global minimum, while a non-convex function can have multiple local minima. Gradient descent can be used on both types of functions, but it may not find the global minimum in non-convex functions.

title: Gradient Descent and Convex Functions
text: Is it true that gradient descent can find the global minimum of a convex function?

title: Gradient Descent and Non-Convex Functions
text: Can gradient descent find the global minimum of a non-convex function?

title: Local Minima in Non-Convex Functions
text: In non-convex functions, gradient descent may converge to a local minimum instead of the global minimum. This is because the algorithm follows the steepest descent path, which may lead to a local minimum.
